_note: Sorting animals (scripts/ui/animal_sort.gd, sort_bar.gd): the four ways, each screen's first choice, the group names and the bar's sizes. A player's last choice on each screen is saved in their profile ("sort").
_screens: Each screen's sort until the player picks one: deck (Your Deck), bans, animals (the Animals tab), starters (round 1 of a match) and army (your army row in a match).
_bar: The full bar (Your Deck, bans, Animals tab) and the compact one inside a match: button height, text size, the gap between buttons and the arrow on the chosen one.
_tab_top: Room above the bar on the Animals tab, under the version label in the corner.
_header: Section headers in the big grids: text size and icon size.
_marker: Inside a match, instead of headers. Round 1: a line in each group's color in the gap under its cards (line thick, rows row_gap apart), with the group's tag (tag_height tall, its icon tag_icon) on the first one. Your army row: a thin divider before each group (divider_width wide, its icon divider_icon).
